synchronize.command.help.title: Synchronize Command Help
synchronize.command.help.note: Note: All synchronize commands can ONLY be executed from the server console.
synchronize.command.help.add_files: Adds file(s) or a directory to the synchronization list.
synchronize.command.help.add_files.optio: Marks the added files as optional for the client.
synchronize.command.help.add_files.shall: Only scans the top-level folder, ignoring sub-directories.
synchronize.command.help.add_files.resta: Forces a client restart before joining (ignored for files targeting the 'mods' folder).
synchronize.command.help.add_files.desti: Overrides the relative destination path on the client side.
synchronize.command.help.remove_files: Removes file(s) matching the path from the sync list.
synchronize.command.help.refresh: Re-checks all tracked files, updates file hashes, and reloads config/synchronize/config.json.
